cbv13:2.1: While fulfilling the conditions for Awakening he was born from a peahen’s womb.
cbv13:2.2: As the Great Being was protected with (a safeguard) the forest dwellers
cbv13:2.3: were unable to catch him, though they endeavoured for a long time.
cbv13:2.4: It is declared to be “Brahma’s Charm”, we will recite that safeguard.
